# Shop helpers (fictional)

| Field | Required | Description |
| :- | :- | :- |
| `name` | Yes | Unique identifier of the helper |
| `description` | Yes | When the shop should call it |
| `model` | No | Model to use: `small`, `large`, or `inherit` |
| `permissionMode` | No | One of `ask`, `trust`, or `lock` |
| `cartLimit` | No | Maximum basket size the helper may touch |
